title: mxv/ports-reset/v1
description: Each port of the workspace's manifest and the host port that it holds after the reset.

dry_run.description: Present, and true, when the run was a dry run that changed nothing.

cut.description: Present when the output budget cut the result short, so data holds only its first rows.

code.description: The over-budget code, in the tool's spelling.

budget.description: The most bytes that the run printed on standard output.

PortRow.description:
One named port of a workspace and the host port that it holds, as
`mxv ports reset` prints it.

name.description: The port's name in the manifest.

port.description: The host port that the workspace holds for it.
